verdict.rationale: GitHub Copilot's own docs list "code completion and next edit suggestions" and describe completing code and proposing edits in supported editors (VS Code, Visual Studio, JetBrains, Neovim). Hands-on community reports confirm inline completions work as developers type. missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of how next-edit suggestions behave, independent or hands-on corroboration of next-edit suggestions specifically (community evidence covers only basic completions).

support.subject: As a developer, I can receive inline code completions and next-edit suggestions as I type

citations.quote: Unlimited code completion and next edit suggestions
Copilot in your editor does it all, from explaining concepts and completing code, to proposing edits
GitHub Copilot integrates with leading editors, including Visual Studio Code, Visual Studio, JetBrains IDEs, and Neovim
Copilot guesses the exact code I want about one in ten times... when it guesses right, it feels like it's reading my mind.
